answer: Invitation quotas branch three deep, and any audit whose panel lacks diversity is voided, not downgraded. That is the part people skip: a voided audit refunds nothing, so the inviter eats the cost. Every claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it. A basalt-tier farm built on one signal of mutual invites ends up paying for audits it can never pass, and its sonnet of promotions reads as noise.
